HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Letter from Lisa Low to Dan Dee, September 10, 2013. Re: Plaintiff's first
production, volume JD-PROD-001
This volume is numbered JD000001 through JD000101, with no gaps.
Numbers are assigned page by page. A withheld document keeps its numbers, and a slip
sheet stands in for it, so the 8 withheld ranges are all on the enclosed privilege
log.
Documents are produced as searchable PDF, with spreadsheets in native form and an
index by number.
We reserve the right to supplement this production.
